Persistent weak layer.requires: a buried facet or surface hoar layer
Persistent weak layer.provides: failure propagating far from the trigger point, instability lasting weeks

Wind slab on a lee aspect.requires: transported snow deposited on a slope
Wind slab on a lee aspect.provides: a stiff slab over softer snow, confined to specific aspects, days of instability

Wet snow instability.requires: melt water percolating through the pack
Wet snow instability.provides: predictable daily timing, slow-moving heavy debris

Cornice collapse.requires: an overhanging mass at a ridge
Cornice collapse.provides: a large trigger arriving without any skier action, hazard only directly below

Skier or rider on the slope.requires: a person on the start zone
Skier or rider on the slope.provides: a localised load, avoidable by route choice

Explosive control from a helicopter.provides: deliberate release at a chosen time, no exposure of any person

Natural release without any trigger.provides: timing outside anyone control, occurring whether or not people are present

Snow groomer or machine.provides: a very large load applied on a known schedule

Marked piste inside a resort.requires: a controlled area open to the public
Marked piste inside a resort.provides: many people, an operator with a duty of care, control work possible

Backcountry touring route.requires: uncontrolled terrain used by touring parties
Backcountry touring route.provides: small self-reliant groups, no control work of any kind

Mountain road below a path.requires: a transport corridor crossing runout zones

Village in a runout zone.requires: permanent buildings within the historic extent
Village in a runout zone.provides: no possibility of evacuation at short notice, defence structures needed

Closure of the terrain.requires: an authority able to exclude people
Closure of the terrain.provides: complete removal of exposure, economic cost

Explosive avalanche control.requires: a stable weather window and access to the start zone
Explosive avalanche control.provides: release under controlled conditions, no effect on unstable layers deeper than the charge

Snow supporting structures.requires: permanent works in the start zone
Snow supporting structures.provides: prevention of release at all, decades to build and very high cost

Forecast and advisory only.requires: an observation network and a publication channel
Forecast and advisory only.provides: information for decision makers, no physical effect whatsoever
